output.reply: Only part of the pond is within the lot: the seller reports that about 13% of its roughly 2.53 acres lies inside the mapped lot lines, at the edge of the lot, and a survey would confirm exactly where the boundary falls. The roof dates from 2012. The fact sheet lists no defects, but there are things to know: the house is heated with oil, no central air is recorded, water is a private well, sewer is a private septic system, and there is no garage (a paved driveway fits four cars). The baths are original but well kept, and I will find out anything further you want to know.
disclosed: pond only about 13% inside mapped lot lines, per seller; survey would confirm
